plotTwists: {user} reaches out to poke... and {target} isn't actually there. It was a decoy the whole time.
{target} catches {user}'s finger mid-poke. A tense standoff, then both burst out laughing.
The poke somehow triggers a chain reaction — everyone nearby starts poking each other.
A chicken wanders between them at the last second and gets poked instead. 🐔
{user} pokes {target}, but it turns out {target} was ticklish in a way nobody expected — chaos ensues.
Lightning strikes nearby at the exact moment of contact, for dramatic effect. ⚡
The Whisper Merchant appears and tries to sell {target} 'poke-proof armor' on the spot.

npcInteractions.line: Reminds me of my little brother. Insufferable, this one.
Even my bark has felt less annoying pokes.
The King has been notified and finds it mildly amusing.
I have a potion that cures the urge to poke people. You're not buying it, are you.
The winds whispered of this exact chaos.
